results.name: Victor Hugo (1802-1885) - Genealogy - Example Genealogy
results.content: Victor Hugo was born on 26 February 1802 in Besançon, France, son of Léopold Hugo and Sophie Trébuchet. He married Adèle Foucher on 12 October 1822 in Paris.
